scripts.dev: npm run build -w @crypto-terminal/contracts && concurrently -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @crypto-terminal/api" "npm run dev -w @crypto-terminal/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @crypto-terminal/contracts && npm run build -w @crypto-terminal/api && npm run build -w @crypto-terminal/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @crypto-terminal/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @crypto-terminal/api && npm run typecheck -w @crypto-terminal/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @crypto-terminal/api && npm run test -w @crypto-terminal/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @crypto-terminal/api && npm run lint -w @crypto-terminal/web
